title: CDriveView: rows get real hover feedback
description: A real, confirmed gap: with no List(selection:) binding (focusedIndex already owns keyboard/controller selection separately), AppKit's own row hover/pressed feedback never engaged - a row gave zero visual response to the mouse at all, unlike every other tappable row/tile in the app (LibraryEntryTile has had its own .onHover all along). Adds a real onHover-driven background highlight.
commit_message: Add real hover highlight to C: Drive rows
